comments.body: Apart from being one of the best looking gag weapons in the game. +999 to Silliness! That aside, I wonder if this item is going to have some sort of near-future use; I remember during Christmas there was dialogue saying you could give these to an NPC for something. Obviously that doesn't apply with the Spring event at the moment... hmm. I'm going to pick up two, just to be safe.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: During the current Christmas event (which is a repeat of last year's), if you talk to Clause with one of these in your possession, he will give a one-time-per-character reward. I got x20 Pie and fruit tray (Storekeeper aide food), but the reward might be random.

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: 'ey, I got twenty paymaster food, here! I think you're right, it's random, but it must mean you've got a chance of winning any of the six different aide foods. Nice!

comments.author: Me
comments.body: There actually is another use for these, that being grinding Staff/Club techs. Imagine 2 or 3 players equipped with these and their regular weapon as back-up, you could get some seriously long chains and get tech proficiency up really fast for each color. It's the same for Throwing weapons with the weapon called Knife with 0 attack.
